pkgmetadata.longdescription: Copper is a small self-hosting imperative language from https://tibleiz.net/copper. Three backends are built and installed: a native x86-64 ELF writer (copper-elf64), an LLVM backend (copper-llvm, needs llc from the matching LLVM slot when it is used) and a C backend (copper-c). The copper shell script drives them and links programs against the bundled libcopper-std.a and the standard library installed under /usr/share/copper/include.
